review: Five fixed training-source crops per initial class visually inspected by the coding agent before main training; no final-test model predictions used. This was not independent human annotation. Initial ball classes also excluded because most annotated objects fail the prespecified minimum-size rule.

excluded_classes.bee: many selected train crops have difficult subject visibility
excluded_classes.gondola: close-up boat parts and another boat class make identification difficult
excluded_classes.frying_pan: cooked food often dominates the annotated utensil crop
excluded_classes.wok: overlaps visually with frying pan at this resolution
excluded_classes.wooden_spoon: food/partial-handle crops often obscure the spoon
excluded_classes.plate: food frequently dominates the crop and distracts from the labeled plate
